name: Hero Homes The Palatial
summary: The project, developer (Hero Realty), Sector 104 Dwarka Expressway location, under-construction status, ~11 acre land area, 5 towers and ~₹4.9 Cr starting price are confirmed. Our RERA number is valid but only for Phase 2 (Tower D); the project has three registrations. Our unit count (750) does not match any source (500 / 552 / 650), unit sizes differ slightly (2,800 / 3,460 sq ft on portals), and we publish no possession date although portals cite 2028-2030 by phase.
